accepted.s: Which of the following pairs correctly represents the components of the Atal Innovation Mission and their focus?
o: Atal Tinkering Labs—start-ups; Atal Incubation Centres—school laboratories; Mentor India—rural infrastructure
Atal Incubation Centres—school students; Atal Community Innovation Centres—large industries; Atal Tinkering Labs—district rankings
Atal Tinkering Labs—schools; Atal Incubation Centres—start-ups; Atal Community Innovation Centres—rural and underserved areas
Atal Community Innovation Centres—urban start-ups; Atal Incubation Centres—basic infrastructure; Mentor India—school examinations
accepted.x: ATLs operate in schools, AICs support start-ups, and ACICs focus on rural and underserved areas. Mentor India is also a component of AIM.
accepted.tq: Start from the sure pair linking incubation centres with start-ups.
accepted.sec: Atal Innovation Mission - year, parent body, components  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Atal Tinkering Labs primarily cater to students of which classes and promote which combination of activities?
o: Undergraduate students, with exclusive training in agricultural marketing
Grades 9–12, with exclusive training in financial accounting
Grades 6–12, with exposure to IoT, 3D printing and robotics
Grades 1–5, with training only in conventional handicrafts
accepted.x: ATLs are established in schools for students in grades 6–12 and provide exposure to technologies such as IoT, 3D printing and robotics.
accepted.tq: Match the institution with its target group and operational technologies.
accepted.sec: Atal Innovation Mission - year, parent body, components  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The allocation for Atal Tinkering Labs in the Union Budget 2026–27 rose from:
accepted.x: The allocation for ATLs increased from ₹500 crore to ₹3,200 crore in the Union Budget 2026–27.
accepted.tq: Read the paired before-and-after figures together rather than treating them as separate amounts.
accepted.sec: Atal Innovation Mission - year, parent body, components  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Generative-AI assistants are being added to approximately how many Atal Tinkering Labs?
accepted.x: Generative-AI assistants are being added to 10,000 Atal Tinkering Labs.
accepted.tq: Identify the rounded programme scale associated with the technology upgrade.
accepted.sec: Atal Innovation Mission - year, parent body, components  [APPSC]

accepted.s: How many Atal Tinkering Labs are reported to be functioning in Andhra Pradesh?
accepted.x: Andhra Pradesh has 590 Atal Tinkering Labs.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the Andhra Pradesh figure from the national programme totals.
accepted.sec: Atal Innovation Mission - year, parent body, components  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Match List-I with List-II regarding selected NITI Aayog indices.

List-I (Index)
A. Fiscal Health Index
B. State Health Index
C. India Innovation Index
D. Export Preparedness Index

List-II (Top state and edition)
1. Odisha—2025
2. Kerala—2019–20
3. Karnataka—2021
4. Tamil Nadu—2022

Select the correct answer using the code given below:
accepted.x: The Fiscal Health Index was topped by Odisha in 2025, the State Health Index by Kerala in 2019–20, the India Innovation Index by Karnataka in 2021, and the Export Preparedness Index by Tamil Nadu in 2022.
accepted.tq: Start from a sure pair and check that every index is matched with its correct edition and state.
accepted.sec: State rankings → top state, AP position  [other exams]

accepted.s: NITI Aayog is also the nodal institution for India’s Global Innovation Index ranking, which improved from 81 in 2015 to 38 in 2025. India’s 2025 rank was out of:
accepted.x: India ranked 38th out of 139 countries in 2025, improving from 81st position in 2015.
accepted.tq: Separate the rank achieved from the total number of countries covered.
accepted.sec: State rankings → top state, AP position  [other exams]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the SDG India Index categories:
1. A score of 100 is classified as Achiever.
2. A score between 65 and 99 is classified as Front Runner.
3. A score below 50 is classified as Aspirant.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. The remaining category, Performer, covers scores from 50 to 64.
accepted.tq: Check the boundary values in the category table before selecting the coded combination.
accepted.sec: SDG India Index categories and nodal body  [other exams]

accepted.s: Which institution frames the National Indicator Framework for the Sustainable Development Goals in India?
o: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation
Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change
accepted.x: MoSPI frames the National Indicator Framework, while NITI Aayog oversees the SDGs.
accepted.tq: Discriminate between the institution that oversees the SDGs and the institution that frames the indicator framework.
accepted.sec: SDG India Index categories and nodal body  [other exams]

accepted.s: The localised Sustainable Development Goals framework of Andhra Pradesh contains how many indicators?
accepted.x: Andhra Pradesh has developed its own localised SDG framework containing 475 indicators.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the AP indicator count from the block and ATL figures appearing in the same topic.
accepted.sec: SDG India Index categories and nodal body  [other exams]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about the Aspirational Districts Programme:
1. It was launched in January 2018.
2. It covers 112 districts.
3. Progress is measured through 49 indicators.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: The programme was launched in January 2018, covers 112 districts and tracks progress through 49 indicators.
accepted.tq: Combine the date, coverage and indicator count before choosing the coded option.
accepted.sec: Aspirational Districts Programme  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The strategy of the Aspirational Districts Programme is based on which of the following three principles?
accepted.x: The three principles are Convergence, Collaboration and Competition, commonly described as the 3 Cs.
accepted.tq: Use the well-known three-C formulation and reject substituted administrative terms.
accepted.sec: Aspirational Districts Programme  [APPSC]

accepted.s: District rankings under the Aspirational Districts Programme are displayed on which platform?
accepted.x: The programme uses the Champions of Change dashboard for district rankings, including monthly delta rankings.
accepted.tq: Identify the dedicated dashboard rather than a similarly named index portal.
accepted.sec: Aspirational Districts Programme  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Match List-I with List-II regarding the themes and weights of the Aspirational Districts Programme.

List-I (Theme)
A. Health and Nutrition
B. Education
C. Agriculture and Water Resources
D. Basic Infrastructure

List-II (Weight)
1. 10 percent
2. 30 percent
3. 20 percent
4. 30 percent

Select the correct answer using the code given below:
accepted.x: Health and Nutrition and Education each carry 30 percent; Agriculture and Water Resources carries 20 percent; Basic Infrastructure carries 10 percent.
accepted.tq: Use the repeated 30-percent weight as the anchor and then place the 20- and 10-percent themes.
accepted.sec: Aspirational Districts Programme  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following is NOT correctly matched with its weight under the Aspirational Districts Programme?
o: Financial Inclusion and Skill Development—20 percent
accepted.x: Financial Inclusion and Skill Development carries 10 percent, not 20 percent. Agriculture and Water Resources carries 20 percent.
accepted.tq: Find the single reversed weight among otherwise correctly matched pairs.
accepted.sec: Aspirational Districts Programme  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which set represents the districts of Andhra Pradesh originally covered under the Aspirational Districts Programme?
o: Alluri Sitharama Raju, Parvathipuram Manyam and YSR Kadapa
Visakhapatnam, Alluri Sitharama Raju and Parvathipuram Manyam
accepted.x: The districts originally covered in Andhra Pradesh were Visakhapatnam, Vizianagaram and YSR Kadapa. Later lists identify a different set of districts after administrative changes.
accepted.tq: Watch for the time qualifier ‘originally’ and distinguish it from later district lists.
accepted.sec: Aspirational Districts Programme  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following is the current set of Andhra Pradesh aspirational districts identified for the programme?
o: Alluri Sitharama Raju, Anakapalli and Vizianagaram
Alluri Sitharama Raju, Parvathipuram Manyam and YSR Kadapa
accepted.x: The identified Andhra Pradesh aspirational districts are Alluri Sitharama Raju, Parvathipuram Manyam and YSR Kadapa.
accepted.tq: Separate the current administrative list from the programme’s original district list.
accepted.sec: Aspirational Districts Programme  [APPSC]

accepted.s: In the March 2026 rankings, which Andhra Pradesh aspirational district stood first in India in the Basic Infrastructure theme?
accepted.x: Alluri Sitharama Raju district ranked first in India in the Basic Infrastructure theme in the March 2026 rankings.
accepted.tq: Match the district with the specific theme instead of the overall programme ranking.
accepted.sec: Aspirational Districts Programme  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The Aspirational Blocks Programme was launched in:
accepted.x: The Aspirational Blocks Programme was launched in January 2023.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the launch year of the blocks programme from that of the districts programme.
accepted.sec: Aspirational Blocks Programme - launch and indicators

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the Aspirational Blocks Programme:
1. It covers 513 blocks.
2. These blocks are spread across 27 States and 4 Union Territories.
3. The blocks are located in 329 districts.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: The programme covers 513 blocks in 329 districts across 27 States and 4 Union Territories.
accepted.tq: Check all three dimensions of coverage—blocks, districts and States/Union Territories.
accepted.sec: Aspirational Blocks Programme - launch and indicators

accepted.s: The Aspirational Blocks Programme tracks approximately how many key indicators across areas such as health, education, agriculture, infrastructure and social development?
accepted.x: The programme tracks about 40 key indicators across health, education, agriculture, infrastructure and social development.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the approximate block-level indicator count from the 49 indicators of the district programme.
accepted.sec: Aspirational Blocks Programme - launch and indicators

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly describes Sampoornata Abhiyan 2.0?
o: It is confined to improving only the infrastructure indicators of aspirational districts.
It aims to saturate key indicators in both the Aspirational Districts and Aspirational Blocks Programmes.
It ranks only the States covered by the Sustainable Development Goals Index.
It seeks to replace the Aspirational Districts Programme with the Aspirational Blocks Programme.
accepted.x: Sampoornata Abhiyan 2.0 aims to achieve saturation of key indicators in both the Aspirational Districts and Aspirational Blocks Programmes.
accepted.tq: Identify the programme’s scope by checking whether it covers both levels or only one.
accepted.sec: Aspirational Blocks Programme - launch and indicators

accepted.s: The NITI Aayog–UNICEF Statement of Intent relating to aspirational districts and blocks covers which subject area?
accepted.x: The Statement of Intent between NITI Aayog and UNICEF covers health and nutrition in aspirational districts and blocks.
accepted.tq: Use the subject-area association to distinguish the partnership from economic and industrial indices.
accepted.sec: Aspirational Blocks Programme - launch and indicators

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about NITI Aayog’s index-related work:
1. It publishes the Composite Water Management Index.
2. It publishes the Export Preparedness Index.
3. It publishes the School Education Quality Index.
4. It undertakes Water Budgeting in Aspirational Blocks.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: NITI Aayog publishes the Composite Water Management, Export Preparedness and School Education Quality indices, and also undertakes Water Budgeting in Aspirational Blocks.
accepted.tq: Test the complete institutional list and avoid excluding the less familiar water-budgeting activity.
accepted.sec: State rankings → top state, AP position  [other exams]

accepted.s: Which pair is correctly matched?
accepted.x: Gujarat topped the Composite Water Management Index in 2019. Kerala topped the School Education Quality Index in 2019, Tamil Nadu topped the Export Preparedness Index in 2022, and Kerala topped the State Health Index in the 2019–20 round.
accepted.tq: Check both the index name and the leading state before accepting a pair.
accepted.sec: State rankings → top state, AP position  [other exams]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the Fiscal Health Index 2026:
1. Odisha ranked first among the major States for the second consecutive year.
2. Punjab was placed last among the major States.
3. Arunachal Pradesh ranked first among the North-Eastern and Himalayan States.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: Odisha ranked first among major States for the second year running, Punjab was last, and Arunachal Pradesh led the North-Eastern and Himalayan States.
accepted.tq: Keep the two comparison groups separate: major States versus North-Eastern and Himalayan States.
accepted.sec: State rankings → top state, AP position  [other exams]
